tim_witness.character_reading: Juice is one of Tim's clearest theological pressure-test figures. He repeatedly forces creator, First-Mover and moral claims into argument, later appears in Garden-conflict scenes, then re-enters a return/trust corridor. The useful character judgment is not 'antagonist' but recurring friction that can either sharpen ideas or become disruption.

fruit.reading: Juice produces intellectual pressure that can clarify doctrine, but Tim's Chronicle also places him in conflict/disruption. The December trust-return scene makes the relation reversible.

karma.reading: No secure individual karma balance is recovered. In Tim's framework, honest challenge can be generative; repeated disruption without repair can become debt/noise. The surviving record contains both possibilities.

placement.reading: Juice belongs primarily at Debate/Threshold: a figure who presses claims and repeatedly approaches the question of return/trust.

tim_witness.boundary: Judas-in-the-Cup/Rational Soul are project-era aliases, not neutral moral verdicts. Theological opposition is not itself proof of negative character.
